## Setup

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

## Create folders if missing:
root_dir <- knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir")
figs_dir <- paste0(root_dir, "/figures")
results_dir <- paste0(root_dir, "/results")
data_derived_dir <- paste0(root_dir, "/data_derived")
if(!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir)
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir)
if(!dir.exists(data_derived_dir)) dir.create(data_derived_dir)

## Allow duplicate labels:
options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")
```


## Check packages

```{r, message=FALSE}
stopifnot(
  requireNamespace("data.table"),
  requireNamespace("rmarkdown"),
  requireNamespace("knitr"),
  requireNamespace("meta"),
  requireNamespace("readxl"),
  requireNamespace("writexl"),
  requireNamespace("varhandle"),
  requireNamespace("grid"),

)
```


## Reports included in the workflow

The reports are rendered in the order specified below.

```{r report_files}
report_files <- c(
  "10_prepare_data.Rmd",
  "21_overview_forest_plots.Rmd",
  "30_manus_forest_plots.Rmd",
  "32_manus_funnel_plots.Rmd",
  "35_table_1.Rmd",
  "36_leave1out.Rmd"
)

report_paths <- file.path(
  "reports_pico2",
  report_files
)

missing_reports <- report_paths[!file.exists(report_paths)]

if (length(missing_reports) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The following required reports are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_reports, collapse = "\n"),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

report_files
```

## Render reports

Render all PICO 2 reports in the specified order:

```{r render_reports}
for (path in report_paths) {
  message("Rendering: ", path)

  tryCatch(
    rmarkdown::render(
      input = path,
      quiet = TRUE,
      envir = new.env()
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        "Rendering failed for ",
        path,
        ":\n",
        conditionMessage(e),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
}
```
